import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def linear_search_lower_bound_precond (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  seq.size ≤ 0x7FFFFFFF ∧
  (∀ i j : Nat, i < j ∧ j < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≤ seq.getD j 0)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def linearSearchLowerBoundAux
    (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (index fuel : Nat) : Nat :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => index
  | fuel + 1 =>
      if index < seq.size then
        if seq.getD index 0 < target then
          linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target (index + 1) fuel
        else
          index
      else
        index
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def linear_search_lower_bound (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (h_precond : linear_search_lower_bound_precond seq target) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target 0 seq.size
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def linear_search_lower_bound_postcond (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (result : Nat) (h_precond : linear_search_lower_bound_precond seq target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result ≤ seq.size ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < result → seq.getD i 0 < target) ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, result ≤ i ∧ i < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≥ target)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem linearSearchLowerBoundAux_step
    (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (index fuel : Nat)
    (hindex : index < seq.size)
    (hvalue : seq.getD index 0 < target) :
    linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target index (fuel + 1) =
      linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target (index + 1) fuel := by
  have hvalue' : seq[index] < target := by
    simpa [hindex] using hvalue
  simp [linearSearchLowerBoundAux, hindex, hvalue']

theorem linearSearchLowerBoundAux_stop
    (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (index fuel : Nat)
    (hindex : index < seq.size)
    (hvalue : ¬seq.getD index 0 < target) :
    linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target index (fuel + 1) = index := by
  have hvalue' : ¬seq[index] < target := by
    simpa [hindex] using hvalue
  simp [linearSearchLowerBoundAux, hindex, hvalue']

theorem linearSearchLowerBoundAux_spec
    (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (index fuel : Nat)
    (hindex : index ≤ seq.size)
    (hfuel : fuel = seq.size - index) :
    linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target index fuel ≤ seq.size ∧
    (∀ j : Nat,
      index ≤ j ∧
      j < linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target index fuel →
      seq.getD j 0 < target) ∧
    (linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target index fuel < seq.size →
      target ≤ seq.getD
        (linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target index fuel) 0) := by
  induction fuel generalizing index with
  | zero =>
      have hindex_eq : index = seq.size := by
        omega
      subst index
      simp [linearSearchLowerBoundAux]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hindex_lt : index < seq.size := by
        omega
      by_cases hvalue : seq.getD index 0 < target
      · have hnext : index + 1 ≤ seq.size := by
          omega
        have hnext_fuel : fuel = seq.size - (index + 1) := by
          omega
        rcases ih (index := index + 1) hnext hnext_fuel with
          ⟨hbound, hbefore, hfound⟩
        rw [linearSearchLowerBoundAux_step
          seq target index fuel hindex_lt hvalue]
        refine ⟨hbound, ?_, hfound⟩
        intro j hj
        by_cases hjindex : j = index
        · subst j
          exact hvalue
        · apply hbefore j
          constructor <;> omega
      · rw [linearSearchLowerBoundAux_stop
          seq target index fuel hindex_lt hvalue]
        refine ⟨hindex, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro j hj
          omega
        · intro _
          omega
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem linear_search_lower_bound_postcond_satisfied (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (h_precond : linear_search_lower_bound_precond seq target) :
    linear_search_lower_bound_postcond seq target (linear_search_lower_bound seq target h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  change
    linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target 0 seq.size ≤ seq.size ∧
    (∀ i : Nat,
      i < linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target 0 seq.size →
      seq.getD i 0 < target) ∧
    (∀ i : Nat,
      linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target 0 seq.size ≤ i ∧
      i < seq.size →
      seq.getD i 0 ≥ target)

  rcases linearSearchLowerBoundAux_spec seq target 0 seq.size
      (by omega) (by simp) with
    ⟨hbound, hbefore, hfound⟩

  refine ⟨hbound, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    exact hbefore i ⟨Nat.zero_le i, hi⟩
  · intro i hi
    rcases hi with ⟨hresult_le, hi_size⟩
    by_cases heq :
        i = linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target 0 seq.size
    · subst i
      exact hfound hi_size
    · have hresult_lt :
          linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target 0 seq.size < i := by
        omega
      have hresult_size :
          linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target 0 seq.size < seq.size := by
        omega
      have hsorted :=
        h_precond.2
          (linearSearchLowerBoundAux seq target 0 seq.size)
          i
          ⟨hresult_lt, hi_size⟩
      exact le_trans (hfound hresult_size) hsorted
  -- !benchmark @end proof
